summary: Slice 4 of the revision-1 tidy-up: finished the App-level test updates. Added the missing AppThemesTestsUpdate piece in src/App.themes.test.tsx, an R3 test proving Shell and Theme sit in the visible Appearance group and are reachable without opening a dialog or the hidden Utilities menu (and that changing Shell and opening the Theme menu still work). Confirmed the rest of the design already in the tree and passing: grouped TopBar (Brand/Appearance/Create/Utilities) and UtilitiesMenu, persistent AppFooter, the collapsible git branch chip, lazy ConsoleNav/GitDrawer/EditPane/ThemeFinder/CommandPalette, and the shared shortcut registry. No Rust, src/api, permission, CSP or dependency changes. Ran npm run lint (tsc --noEmit) clean, npm test with 388 passing tests in 42 files, and npm run build successfully.
